doc: Produce a (tokens, vocab) indicator matrix; row t has a one at ids[t] and zeros elsewhere.
name: make_one_hot

doc: Build a one-hot matrix O of shape (tokens x vocab): O[t, i] = 1 if ids[t] == i else 0. x is the flat ids tensor of `tokens` integer indices in [0, vocab).
name: one_hot
reference:
def fn(x, tokens, vocab):
    flat = x.reshape(-1).long()
    oh = torch.zeros(tokens, vocab, dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
    oh[torch.arange(tokens, device=x.device), flat] = 1.0
    return oh
